translations.literal: The Jurchens soon took Hui to the army headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens soon took Hui before the army headquarters.

translations.zh: 三月，金人立邦昌為偽楚。
translations.literal: In the third month the Jurchens installed Bangchang as ruler of the false Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Jurchens installed Bangchang as ruler of the puppet Chu.

translations.zh: 邦昌遺金書請還孫傅、張叔夜及檜，不許。
translations.literal: Bangchang sent a letter to the Jurchens requesting the return of Sun Fu, Zhang Shuye, and Hui, but it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Bangchang sent a letter to the Jurchens requesting the return of Sun Fu, Zhang Shuye, and Hui, but the request was denied.

translations.zh: 初，二帝北遷，檜與傅、叔夜、何㮚，司馬朴從至燕山，又徙韓州。
translations.literal: Earlier, when the two emperors were moved north, Hui followed with Fu, Shuye, He Li, and Sima Pu as far as Yanshan, and was then transferred to Hanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the two emperors were moved north, Hui followed with Sun Fu, Zhang Shuye, He Li, and Sima Pu as far as Yanshan, and was then transferred to Hanzhou.

translations.zh: 上皇聞康王即位，作書貽粘罕，與約和議，俾檜潤色之。
translations.literal: When the Retired Emperor heard that the Prince of Kang had ascended the throne, he composed a letter to Nianhan proposing peace talks and had Hui polish it.
translations.idiomatic: When the Retired Emperor heard that the Prince of Kang had taken the throne, he composed a letter to Nianhan proposing peace talks and had Hui polish it.

translations.literal: Hui conveyed generous bribes to reach Nianhan.
translations.idiomatic: Hui conveyed generous bribes to reach Nianhan.

translations.zh: 會金主吳乞買以檜賜其弟撻懶為任用，撻懶攻山陽，建炎四年十月甲辰，檜與妻王氏及婢僕一家，自軍中取漣水軍水砦航海歸行在。
translations.literal: When Jin ruler Wuqimai gave Hui to his younger brother Tatala for employment, and Tatala attacked Shanyang, on jiachen in the tenth month of the fourth year of Jianyan Hui, with his wife Lady Wang and the whole household of maids and servants, left the army at the Lianshui naval water fort and returned by sea to the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin ruler Wuqimai gave Hui to his younger brother Tatala for employment, and Tatala attacked Shanyang, on jiachen in the tenth month of the fourth year of Jianyan Hui, with his wife Lady Wang and their entire household of maids and servants, left the army at the Lianshui naval water fort and returned by sea to the traveling court.

translations.literal: On bingwu Hui entered for an audience.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Hui entered for an audience.

translations.zh: 丁未，拜禮部尚書，賜以銀帛。
translations.literal: On dingwei he was appointed Minister of Rites and granted silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he was appointed Minister of Rites and granted silver and silks.
